fact: LTA Commissioner Angela Cassell Bush said Liberia's IXP, hosted by the Cable Consortium of Liberia (CCL) in Monrovia area, remains functional, though governance problems and limited ISP participation persist and many ISPs are not yet peering there; the date is the document's published date, as the page shows none.

The African Union Commission and Liberia's Ministry of Posts and Telecommunications officially launched the Liberian Internet Exchange Point (LIXP) in Monrovia on 6 August 2015, with equipment and technical support from the AXIS project.
The Liberia Telecommunications Authority says the Cable Consortium of Liberia took delivery of new LTA-funded equipment to strengthen operations at the Liberia Internet Exchange Point.
The African IXP Association's undated list of exchange points, retrieved 2026-11-09, names for Liberia: LIXP, Monrovia.
